assumptions: Room areas are the publisher’s values, not measured from this simplified mesh. The floor subtotals differ by 0.01 m² from the published usable total due to rounding.

Floor-to-floor height 3.30 m is inferred. Clear room height 2.70 m and overall height 7.55 m are published; parapet and roof build-up are approximate.

Doors, window sill heights, railings and stair risers are conceptual details inferred from the drawings and exterior images. Furniture now follows the original drawing using licensed library derivatives.

The full visible envelope including terraces is approximately 14 × 15 m. Placement uses the earlier sketch and image-derived plot; it is not a surveyed or approved setback study.
